note: Curated GOLD for the metastore MEMORY oracle (recall@k), dogfooded on keryx's OWN .metaproject/memory/ corpus (8 content entries at capture time, listed under repo below). Each query paraphrases one entry's title/summary closely enough that its relevance is OBVIOUS and no other entry in the corpus is about the same fact; only that one entry is hand-labeled relevant per query. No relevance is inferred from shared tags or topical adjacency (e.g. the allowlist and stale-binary entries share no gold overlap with each other even though they both score highly under some queries in memory-search-results.json). Shape matches the AffectedSetFile the CLI already loads: `target` is the query, `affected` is the gold id list (memory entry `relativePath`s), plus a `justification` field carried for audit (not consumed by the loader).

targets.target: flow ids allocated per clone worktree
targets.justification: Query paraphrases the entry title verbatim ("Flow ids are allocated per clone, not per checkout"); no other corpus entry concerns flow id allocation.

targets.target: stale installed keryx binary review pipeline
targets.justification: Query paraphrases the entry title verbatim ("The keryx on PATH is a stale build; the review pipeline does not exercise the code under review"); no other corpus entry concerns a stale installed binary.

targets.target: shell allowlist not a security boundary
targets.justification: Query paraphrases the entry title verbatim ("A shell allowlist matched against the raw command string is not a security boundary"); no other corpus entry concerns shell allowlists.

targets.target: alignSelf collapses intrinsic height opentui scrollbox
targets.justification: Query paraphrases the entry title/summary verbatim ("OpenTUI: alignSelf on a transcript box collapses its intrinsic height"); no other corpus entry concerns OpenTUI layout.

targets.target: regex source guard loses spelling AST rewrite
targets.justification: Query paraphrases the entry title verbatim ("A source guard loses one spelling per round — and matching the AST only slows it down"); the related entry code-blanks-string-literals.md is deliberately NOT included in gold — it is a distinct, narrower fact (string-literal blanking) that this query does not name, so labeling it relevant would be inventing relevance rather than reading it off the query.
